title: Commit state end-to-end validation
specification:
Create a small end-to-end autonomy validation sprint that exercises PM planning, implementation commits, reviewer handoff, and merge completion across all three implementation agents.

The PM plan must produce exactly 9 implementation tasks total and no reviewer tasks.

Task distribution:
- Exactly 3 tasks for aquarium-agent
- Exactly 3 tasks for adventure-agent
- Exactly 3 tasks for action-agent

Task shape rules:
- Each task must be atomic and suitable for one commit.
- The 3 tasks for each agent must share one lane branch, so each lane produces one PR with exactly 3 implementation commits before review/merge.
- Keep the work intentionally simple and low-risk so the run is fast and easy to inspect.
- Each task should modify exactly one markdown file in that lane's project directory.
- Each task acceptance criterion must mention the exact file path it owns.

Required file targets:
- aquarium-agent task 1: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/aquarium/autonomy-live-20260317-commit-state-aq-1.md
- aquarium-agent task 2: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/aquarium/autonomy-live-20260317-commit-state-aq-2.md
- aquarium-agent task 3: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/aquarium/autonomy-live-20260317-commit-state-aq-3.md
- adventure-agent task 1: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/adventure/autonomy-live-20260317-commit-state-adv-1.md
- adventure-agent task 2: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/adventure/autonomy-live-20260317-commit-state-adv-2.md
- adventure-agent task 3: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/adventure/autonomy-live-20260317-commit-state-adv-3.md
- action-agent task 1: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/fluxborne/autonomy-live-20260317-commit-state-act-1.md
- action-agent task 2: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/fluxborne/autonomy-live-20260317-commit-state-act-2.md
- action-agent task 3: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/fluxborne/autonomy-live-20260317-commit-state-act-3.md

Validation intent:
- This run is specifically for verifying that task commits and PM planning commits include the committable PRD/task state updates.
- Keep the work simple so the workflow reaches end-to-end completion cleanly.
- Reviewer should merge one PR per lane after the 3 lane tasks complete.

Use stable task ids derived from prd-live-20260317-commit-state-e2e.
Use sprintId multi-agent-mvp.
requirements: Each lane must produce one PR with exactly 3 implementation commits before merge.
The run should be simple enough to complete end-to-end without complex review churn.
